description.text: Understand telecom expense management, match invoices to contracts and services, and choose practical controls for allocation, audits and daily operations.

snippet.exactText: Telecom expense management (TEM) combines service inventory, contract management, invoice checks, cost allocation and supplier follow-up. TEM gives finance and operations teams a way to explain what they pay for, identify differences and document the outcome. A useful program connects each charge to a service, an owner and applicable terms.
